query:
UPDATE media_item
            SET has_thumbnails = $16,
                hash = $2,
                width = $3,
                height = $4,
                is_video = $5,
                duration_ms = $6,
                taken_at_local = $7,
                taken_at_utc = $8,
                og_taken_at_local = $9,
                sort_timestamp = $10,
                orientation = $11,
                use_panorama_viewer = $12,
                timezone_name = $13,
                timezone_offset_seconds = $14,
                og_timezone_offset_seconds = $15
            WHERE id = $1
